claims.population: Umuahia has a population of 359,230 according to the 2006 Nigerian census.
claims.climate: Umuahia is classified Am by the Koppen-Geiger system; precipitation averages 2153 mm; the wetter season runs from March 28 to November 8 and the dry season from November 8 to March 28.
claims.economy: Umuahia is renowned as a railway and agricultural market center where traders and farmers sell yams, cassava, corn, taro, citrus fruits, and palm oil and kernels; a brewery and a palm-oil-processing plant help drive the economy.
claims.crafts: In precolonial times Umuahia was a central marketplace where merchants of produce, pottery, crafts, textile, traditional medicine, palm wine and tools traded.
claims.station: The trading post along the rail route built by the United African Company was named Umuahia-Ibeku Station.
claims.hospital: Umuahia has hospitals such as the Federal Medical Centre, Umuahia (formerly Queen Elizabeth Hospital).
